facts.fact: Cabinet approved the Zimbabwe National Artificial Intelligence Charter, which its briefing statement says carries binding ethical principles and commitments and protects against AI misuse for fraud, exploitation and other harms.

ZWE.note: AI in the Zimbabwe Case Management System is only suggested as a possibility by the minister.
The child-welfare case system use is only proposed; no sector AI tool is piloted or in service.

facts.fact: The Zimbabwe National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2026-2030) was launched by President Mnangagwa in March 2026 and is described as governing the Cabinet-approved AI Charter's framework.

ZWE.note: Nothing on AI models, datasets or computing built in the country.
The minister names four capacity priorities for public servants but no programme or course is stated.
Only the AI strategy and Vision 2030 are mentioned; no national digital strategy is described.
The survey's finding on barriers for persons with disabilities is not a law, programme or delivery.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

ZWE.note: The Case Management System named is for child welfare officers, not courts.
